methodology: official docs + live API probe + JS/HTML analysis + web search

overview.team: Former Binance Futures founding team + Goldman Sachs alumni
overview.correct_domain: standx.com (NOT standx.trade — that domain is a broken PHP deployment)

onboarding.model: Wallet-first (Connect Wallet), no email/social login visible
onboarding.embedded_wallet: No embedded wallet / Privy / Dynamic.xyz signals found in CSP or HTML
onboarding.wallet_system: Two-wallet: Cash Wallet (deposit holding) + Perps Wallet (active trading). Users deposit DUSD then transfer internally.
onboarding.first_trade_guide: Dedicated tutorial for Binance Wallet users

api_auth.model: JWT via wallet signature — no traditional API keys (self-custodial)
flow: 1. Generate temporary ed25519 key pair, base58-encode public key as requestId
2. POST https://api.standx.com/v1/offchain/prepare-signin?chain=<bsc|solana> with {address, requestId} → returns signedData JWT
4. Sign message with wallet (EVM: ECDSA via ethers.js, Solana: ed25519)
5. POST https://api.standx.com/v1/offchain/login?chain=<chain> with {signature, signedData, expiresSeconds} → returns JWT (default 7 days)

token_management.note: Signing keys generated client-side only; StandX never stores them. Revocable immediately.

websocket.limits: Max 24h connection, ping/10s, max 10 concurrent WS/IP, max 30 new connections/min/IP

depth_book.note: Live order book with bid/ask levels

prepare_signin.note: Returns valid signedData JWT for our test wallet. SIWE message with chainId=56 (BSC).

rate_limits.per_account: Token bucket, 45 credits/req, 1000 credits/sec replenish, burst 900 credits (~20 req), sustained ~22 req/sec

sdk: No official SDK. Auth examples in TypeScript for EVM (ethers.js) and SVM (@solana/web3.js).

assessment.web2_friendliness: Low. Wallet-first only, no email/social login, no embedded wallet signals.
assessment.api_order_usability: High. Full REST + WebSocket trading API with comprehensive endpoints. JWT auth via wallet signature is well-documented with EVM + Solana examples.
key_friction_points: Must hold DUSD (proprietary stablecoin) — not standard USDC/USDT
Two-wallet system (Cash + Perps) adds transfer step
Ed25519 key pair generation + body signature required for write operations
Only 4 markets currently (BTC, ETH, XAU, XAG)
unique_strengths: DUSD yields APY while trading (interest-bearing collateral)
Dual-chain: BSC + Solana with unified API
Self-custodial API token management with configurable permissions/expiry
Clean REST API design comparable to CEX APIs
